CoreNetworkId.description: ID of the CoreNetwork that the attachment will be attached to.

CoreNetworkArn.description: The ARN of a core network.

OwnerAccountId.description: The ID of the attachment account owner.

AttachmentPolicyRuleNumber.description: The policy rule number associated with the attachment.

SegmentName.description: The name of the segment attachment.

ProposedSegmentChange.description: The attachment to move from one segment to another.

NetworkFunctionGroupName.description: The name of the network function group attachment.

ProposedNetworkFunctionGroupChange.description: The attachment to move from one network function group to another.

UpdatedAt.description: Last update time of the attachment.

NatGatewaySupport.description: Whether NAT gateway support is enabled on the attachment. Required when NatGatewayRules lists rules. Set to DISABLE with NatGatewayRules to keep the rules on the attachment without translating traffic, and set it to ENABLE to activate them again. An attachment that is pending acceptance applies this setting once it is accepted. Only the core network owner can configure or read NAT gateway settings. Not available in AWS GovCloud (US).

NatSystemRouteSupport.description: Whether system routes are installed for the NAT CIDRs of the attachment's NAT gateway rules. On Connect attachments this is always false and is not configurable. Not available in AWS GovCloud (US).

NatGatewayRules.description: The complete set of NAT gateway rules on the attachment. Updating this property replaces the entire rule set, and rules left out of the new value are removed. To remove all rules, specify an empty list or remove this property. NAT gateway support can't be enabled without rules, so it is then disabled unless NatGatewaySupport is specified. Only the core network owner can configure NAT gateway rules. The rules aren't returned when the attachment is read, so drift detection doesn't check them. Not available in AWS GovCloud (US).

LastModificationErrors.description: Errors from the last modification of the attachment.

NatRule.description: A NAT gateway rule on the attachment.

RuleNumber.description: The rule number that uniquely identifies the NAT rule on the attachment.

MatchSourceCidr.description: The IPv4 CIDR that source traffic is matched against for translation.

NatCidr.description: The IPv4 CIDR that matched source traffic is translated into. Must have the same prefix length as MatchSourceCidr.

ProposedSegmentChange.description: The attachment to move from one segment to another.

Tags.description: The list of key-value tags that changed for the segment.

AttachmentPolicyRuleNumber.description: The rule number in the policy document that applies to this change.

SegmentName.description: The name of the segment to change.

ProposedNetworkFunctionGroupChange.description: The attachment to move from one network function group to another.

Tags.description: The key-value tags that changed for the network function group.

AttachmentPolicyRuleNumber.description: The rule number in the policy document that applies to this change.

NetworkFunctionGroupName.description: The name of the network function group to change.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.

Value.description: The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length and cannot be prefixed with aws:. You can use any of the following characters: the set of Unicode letters, digits, whitespace, _, ., /, =, +, and -.
